title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Training Note: Credited Weeks When Dependents Are Added
content:
**What are the credited weeks of a dependency redetermination?** On an Unemployment Benefit Claims record, the credited weeks are the number of weeks by which the allowance increase of a dependency redetermination is multiplied before the result is compared with the wage cap. They depend on how many weekly payments have already been issued on the claim.

**Which payments are counted?** The weekly payments issued on the claim: payment entries of the weekly kind in the claim's payment history. Supplemental payments and reissues are not weekly payments.

**What are the credited weeks at each stage of the claim?**

| Weekly payments issued on the claim | Credited weeks |
|---|---|
| 13 or more | The remaining benefit balance divided by the weekly benefit amount plus the dependency allowance on the claim, rounded up to the whole week |
| At least 1 but fewer than 13 | 0.75 of the program's maximum duration weeks, rounded to the whole week |
| None | The program's maximum duration weeks |

**What does "rounded up to the whole week" mean in the first row?** Any part of a week counts as a whole week: a quotient of exactly 10 stays 10, and a balance that exceeds 10 weekly amounts by as little as 0.01 gives 11. The dependency allowance in the divisor is the allowance on the claim before the redetermination.

**What does "rounded to the whole week" mean in the second row?** The share is rounded to the nearest whole week: 0.75 of 26 weeks is 19.5, giving 20; 0.75 of 13 weeks is 9.75, giving 10; 0.75 of 52 weeks is 39.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- 14 weekly payments issued, remaining balance 5000.00, weekly benefit amount 346.00 and allowance on the claim 15.00: 5000.00 divided by 361.00 is about 13.85, so the credited weeks are 14.
- 14 weekly payments issued, remaining balance 3610.00 with the same weekly amounts: exactly 10 weeks. With a balance of 3610.01 the credited weeks are 11.
- 12 weekly payments issued on a claim whose program has 26 maximum duration weeks: 20 credited weeks.
- No weekly payment issued: the program's maximum duration weeks.
